DECL Shao.OQ3.stage_normalLayerConditionalLaw_real_tendsto
TYPE ∀ (mu : MeasureTheory.Measure ℝ) [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure mu] (J : ℕ) (q a : ℝ),
  (∀ᵐ (x : ℝ) ∂mu, |x| ≤ 4 + √10) →
    ∫ (x : ℝ), Shao.OQ3.normalValue x ∂mu = q →
      ∫ (x : ℝ), x ∂mu = a →
        0 < Shao.OQ3.normalVariance mu →
          0 < (Shao.OQ3.parabolaCovariance mu).det →
            (∀ᵐ (x : ℝ) ∂mu, x ∈ Set.range fun i => Shao.OQ3.stageAtom (fun j => Shao.OQ3.addedAtom ↑j) i) →
              (∀ (i : Fin 4 ⊕ Fin J), 0 < mu.real {Shao.OQ3.stageAtom (fun j => Shao.OQ3.addedAtom ↑j) i}) →
                ∀ (d : ℕ → ℝ),
                  (∃ M, ∀ (n : ℕ), |d n| ≤ M) →
                    (∀ᶠ (n : ℕ) in Filter.atTop, ∃ k, d n + ↑n * q = Shao.OQ3.dyadicMesh J * ↑k) →
                      ∀ (A : Set ℝ),
                        (ProbabilityTheory.gaussianReal 0 (Shao.OQ3.transverseVariance mu).toNNReal) (frontier A) = 0 →
                          Filter.Tendsto (fun n => (Shao.OQ3.normalLayerConditionalLaw mu q a (d n) n).real A)
                            Filter.atTop
                            (nhds ((ProbabilityTheory.gaussianReal 0 (Shao.OQ3.transverseVariance mu).toNNReal).real A))
AXIOMS [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]

DECL Shao.OQ3.normalizedTailCoefficient_stage_subsequence_tendsto_of_stage
TYPE ∀ (w : Shao.OQ3.AtomicIndex → ℝ),
  (∀ (i : Shao.OQ3.AtomicIndex), 0 ≤ w i) →
    HasSum w 1 →
      ∀ (J : ℕ) (q : ℝ),
        1 < q →
          q < 103 / 100 →
            ∫ (x : ℝ), Shao.OQ3.normalValue x ∂Shao.OQ3.atomicMeasure w = q →
              ∫ (x : ℝ), x ∂Shao.OQ3.atomicMeasure w = q / 4 →
                (∀ᵐ (x : ℝ) ∂Shao.OQ3.atomicMeasure w,
                    x ∈ Set.range fun i => Shao.OQ3.stageAtom (fun j => Shao.OQ3.addedAtom ↑j) i) →
                  (∀ (i : Fin 4 ⊕ Fin J),
                      0 < (Shao.OQ3.atomicMeasure w).real {Shao.OQ3.stageAtom (fun j => Shao.OQ3.addedAtom ↑j) i}) →
                    ∀ (m : ℕ → ℕ),
                      Filter.Tendsto m Filter.atTop Filter.atTop →
                        Filter.Tendsto (fun j => Int.fract (↑(m j) * q / Shao.OQ3.dyadicMesh J)) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) →
                          (Summable fun k =>
                              Shao.OQ3.sourceGaussianLayerWeight (Shao.OQ3.atomicMeasure w) q Shao.OQ3.sourceEll
                                (Shao.OQ3.dyadicMesh J * ↑k)) ∧
                            Filter.Tendsto (fun j => Shao.OQ3.normalizedTailCoefficient Shao.OQ3.sourceEll q w (m j))
                              Filter.atTop
                              (nhds
                                (Shao.OQ3.dyadicMesh J / √(Shao.OQ3.normalVariance (Shao.OQ3.atomicMeasure w)) *
                                  ∑' (k : ℤ),
                                    Shao.OQ3.sourceGaussianLayerWeight (Shao.OQ3.atomicMeasure w) q Shao.OQ3.sourceEll
                                      (Shao.OQ3.dyadicMesh J * ↑k)))
AXIOMS [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]
